column7: Read-path cache stale-stamp class: a generation that does not change when a cached column changes. secret_nodes.updated_at alone missed TryIncrementSecretNodeReadCount's UpdateColumn write, so a warm entry served read_count=0 and RotateSecret's GetSecret-mutate-Save round-trip wrote that stale zero back, granting a fresh budget to a burn-after-N-reads secret (#133/#2764, TestMaxReads_SurvivesRotateAndRollback red on c87207ac3). Closed by deriving each stamp from the columns it caches ((updated_at, read_count) for nodes; (count, max(version_number), sum(read_count)) for versions, with no clock in it) and by this AST scan, which fails on any hook-bypassing write to a cached table touching a column no generation observes and refuses to pass vacuously. Sibling guard for the explicit-counter case: TestRolePermissionWriters_BumpTheGenerationInTheSameTransaction
